concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Protoceratops andrewsi living reconstruction guided by Carnegie CM9185 mounted skeleton photograph and NHM species context. Not a scan or exact replica.

scientific_limits.en: Soft tissue, keratin beak thickness, skin, colors, posture and dimensions are estimates. Mounted bones may include reconstruction. Frill openings in the skeleton do not imply open holes through living skin. Historical display sex assignments are not adopted.
scientific_limits.zh: 软组织、角质喙厚度、皮肤、颜色、姿态及尺寸均为估值。装架骨骼可能含复原部分。骨质颈盾的孔洞不意味着活体皮肤上也有贯通孔洞。不采用旧展牌的性别判断。

taxon_scope: Protoceratops andrewsi; CM9185 named skeletal reference

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic envelope between CM9185 display size context and NHM general1.8m; not measured individual.

shape_requirements: Original parrotlike beak and broad frill without long facial horns. Do not reduce to tiny hornless Triceratops with retained long brow horns.
Deep hooked short rostrum, broad rear cranial shield and low quadrupedal body with long tapering tail.
Keep frill distinct from body and neck in frontal/oblique views, with a solid skin-covered surface; no required literal skeletal fenestra holes.
Four weight-bearing limbs with open belly/leg spaces; modest nasal bump allowed but no long face horns.
construction_notes: Original simple low-poly masses; restrained sand/gray palette is artistic.
No speculative sexual dimorphism, defensive scene, eggs, or large frill spikes.
Beak and frill should read before fine skin facets; preserve original gate without extra pose gate.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: parrotlike beak and broad frill without long facial horns. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：鹦鹉状喙与不具长面角的宽颈盾。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block parrotlike beak and broad frill without long facial horns with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织鹦鹉状喙与不具长面角的宽颈盾；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
